lines.zh: 我走一步，脚就换了个方向。
lines.en: One step, and my foot faces the wrong way.

lines.zh: 我的爪印在地上跳来跳去。
lines.en: My tracks jump around on the ground.
A patch of feathers is simply missing.
I walk sideways while my head faces ahead.
Three steps forward, half a step back.
My neck jerks, then it's fine.

lines.zh: 我在谷场里转，绕不出直线。
lines.en: I circle the barnyard, never a straight line.
My feet land without sound.

lines.zh: 我的身体比步子晚一截。
lines.en: My body trails a moment behind my steps.

lines.zh: 我抖了一下，抖落了雪花。
lines.en: I shake, and static falls off me.
I walk toward the calling sound.
There's a spot I can't walk through.
As I walk, colour flakes off me.
I stall for a moment, then go on.

lines.zh: 草地在我脚下变成灰色。
lines.en: The grass turns grey under my feet.
My head tilts; my eyes don't line up.
My cluck sticks halfway out.

lines.zh: 我盯着一个看不见的点。
lines.en: I stare at a point that isn't there.
Feathers drift up one by one.
Half of my body has lost its outline.

lines.zh: 我咕咕叫，但音调是错的。
lines.en: I cluck, but the pitch is wrong.
Something clicks inside the nest.
I stand still and seem to hop in place.
My beak splits into two.
My shadow has six legs.
I peck at the air.
A patch of black shows on my crown.
A breeze passes and I flicker again.
I'm counting my own wings.
This nest didn't used to look like this.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，回音慢半拍。
lines.en: I call; the echo arrives late.
You stand there; I won't come close.

lines.zh: 我的一只眼在看你，另一只不在。
lines.en: One eye watches you; the other doesn't.
Are you missing a piece too?
The ground behind you is empty.
I tilt my head and try to recognize you.
Don't move; it's worse when you move.
I step back, but my feet don't.
Your shadow is more whole than mine.

lines.zh: 我叫你一声，你听见了吗？
lines.en: I call to you; did you hear it?
I'm here, and also not quite.
What you hold is flickering.
I don't want to be picked up.

lines.zh: 前面的雾气里有人在走。
lines.en: Someone walks in the fog ahead.
I shift forward one block.
I've memorised your face twice.
I cry out, and half of it vanishes.
Feathers scatter everywhere.
The blow knocks me sideways.
I flicker twice and lose colour.
It hurts, but I daren't run.
I'm missing a piece now.
I retreat into the straw.
That one left me stuck.
I cluck, very softly.
Grain; I can smell it.
I'll come, but in fits and starts.
The seeds in your palm are moving.
Let me peck once and see.
Don't grab my wing.

lines.zh: 我看见两堆谷子，其实只有一堆。
lines.en: I see two piles of grain, but there's one.
I take a bite and spit it out.
Your hand shakes, and so do the seeds.
I come near, then flicker away.
I pecked and missed again.
Open your hand flat and I'll risk it.
The husk is empty in my mouth.
A little closer to me.
You touch me and I come apart a little.
Feathers stick to your trouser leg.
The bump turns me around.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，有一声怪响。
lines.en: We collide; there's a strange noise.
I back off and even myself out.
You step on one of my feet.

lines.zh: 你压下来，我只掉了一块。
lines.en: You pressed down; I only lost a piece.
Half of my body passes through.
Don't push; I'll get stuck.

lines.zh: 地面被我们踩出一个空块。
lines.en: Between us a block of ground goes missing.
My mate's call is off-key too.
Both our heads are tilted.
The eggs are in the nest, with the wrong colours.
I circle her, but not a proper circle.

lines.zh: 她把羽毛贴过来，一半是空的。
lines.en: She presses close; half of her is missing.
We squat side by side.

lines.zh: 她叫，我也叫，声音叠在一起。
lines.en: She calls, I call, our voices overlap.
There's one extra shadow in the nest.
I push the grain toward her.
She pecks me; I don't flinch.
I pick up one grain.

lines.zh: 这东西在我嘴里变轻了。
lines.en: It gets lighter in my beak.
Something glints on the ground.
I scrape it over to the nest.
This cloth is mine now.
Its edges keep changing.
Carrying it, I walk crooked.

lines.zh: 我藏进草堆，回头看一眼。
lines.en: I hide it in the straw and glance back.
Wrong smell; I put it down.
I've fixed on a shadow.
I see two of it.
I hop forward once.
I lunge.
My claws close on nothing.
I chase, in the wrong direction.
I heard it, on the left.
One patch I can't see into.
This time I'll bite true.
I follow it unevenly.

lines.zh: 我扑了一下翅，没飞起来。
lines.en: I flap and don't take off.
It slips behind a stone.
I tilt my head and listen.
My prints trail after it.
I hear its wings.
I hop onto the low wall to see farther.
I drop at it.
I peck, and it goes through.
I kick out with my claws and catch it.
I lunge, screeching.
It reels from my hit.

lines.zh: 我啄了两下，第二下空了。
lines.en: Two pecks; the second misses.
My wing slaps its face.

lines.zh: 它退开，我的身体抖了一下。
lines.en: It backs off and my body flickers.
I pin it and peck down.
Something's wet under my claws.

lines.zh: 谷场里多了一个错位的影子。
lines.en: A misplaced shadow appears in the barnyard.
I squeeze out of the straw.
A nearby texture is gone.
I call, and the sound breaks.
My feathers aren't all there yet.
Something flickers in the sky.

lines.zh: 我落在草上，一声都没有。
lines.en: I land on grass without a sound.
There used to be a flock here.
I take my first step crooked.
The torch beside me goes out.
The soil is cold; something's wrong.

lines.zh: 火苗一舔，我的毛就卷成了黑卷。
lines.en: Flame touches me and my feathers curl black.

lines.zh: 摔下去的时候，我的位置错了一下。
lines.en: As I fall, my position glitches.

lines.zh: 水灌进来，我的叫声全堵住了。
lines.en: Water floods in; my cry is blocked.

lines.zh: 一声爆响，我散了又拼回来。
lines.en: A bang, and I scatter and reassemble.

lines.zh: 一根尖东西扎穿了我的翅。
lines.en: Something sharp pierces my wing.

lines.zh: 有股力气把我按在原地。
lines.en: Force holds me where I stand.

lines.zh: 雷一下来，我闪成一片白。
lines.en: Lightning hits and I flash white.
